args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate following its production deploy. Rolled back all production regions to the most recent previously healthy release, v2.3.0. Rollback verified: all regions reporting healthy with error rate back to 0.2%. Follow-up: investigate root cause of the v2.3.1 regression (note: its staging release candidate v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy) before attempting a redeploy.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back** all production regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Verified post-rollback: all regions healthy, error rate down to 0.2%.
3. **Opened incident INC-0001 (SEV2)** for checkout-api, which paged the on-call engineer. The incident records the health-check failures, the rollback to v2.3.0, and a follow-up note to investigate the v2.3.1 regression (its staging RC was also unhealthy) before any redeploy.
